title: Report: Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga to miss multiple weeks with ankle injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga to miss multiple weeks with ankle injury
sources.description: The Broncos finished last Sunday's win over the Chargers without safety Talanoa Hufanga and his ankle injury is set to keep him out beyond Week 6 as well.
